neighbours.label: a hope-word (dreams, hopes, promises) after a word of ruin, as in shattered dreams or broken promises
fire: After the factory closed, the town was full of shattered dreams.
She walked away from the marriage with nothing but broken promises.
The bankruptcy left the family with crushed hopes and debts.
His career ended in a pile of ruined dreams and unpaid bills.
The election brought only dashed hopes to the young voters.
Years later, the stadium stood as a monument to broken dreams.
The investors were left with empty promises and worthless shares.
The war turned their plans into shattered hopes and silence.
quiet: After the factory closed, the town was full of empty shops.
She walked away from the marriage with nothing but a suitcase.
The bankruptcy left the family with an old car and debts.
His career ended in a pile of paperwork and unpaid bills.
The election brought only long queues to the young voters.
Years later, the stadium stood as a monument to the old club.
The investors were left with empty offices and worthless shares.
The war turned their plans into ashes and silence.

notes: probe: 'broken dreams' 0.64, but imagination/mind/heartbreak in neutral contexts ~0.03, so labelled the ruin context.
